units.source_text: 大堰邸内，光景十分优裕。

en.t: Within the Oi residence, the scene was one of great comfort and abundance.

units.source_text: 房屋形式也与众不同，别饶雅趣。

en.t: The style of the buildings was also unlike ordinary houses, with a special refined charm.

units.source_text: 加之明石姬的容颜举止，每次看见，都比上次优越。

en.t: Moreover, Akashi no Kimi's beauty and bearing seemed finer each time he saw her.

units.source_text: 比较起身份高贵的女子来，实在并不逊色。

en.t: Compared with women of high rank, she was truly in no way inferior.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“她的品行倘若同别人一样，并无特别优越之处，我不会如此怜爱她。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "If her character were just like everyone else's, with nothing especially superior about it, I would not cherish her so deeply.

units.source_text: 她父亲性行乖僻，确是一大憾事。

en.t: That her father's nature and conduct are eccentric is certainly a great pity.

units.source_text: 至于女儿身份低下，又有何妨？”

en.t: But as for the daughter's low status, what harm is there in that?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子每次来访，都只是匆匆一叙，常感不满。

en.t: Whenever Prince Genji came to visit, he could only speak with her briefly and in haste, and he often felt unsatisfied.

units.source_text: 此次又是急忙归去，他觉得虽然相会，仍是痛苦，

en.t: This time too he had to hurry away, and he felt that even though they had met, it was still painful,

units.source_text: 心中一直慨叹“好似梦中渡雀桥”。

en.t: and in his heart he kept sighing that it was "like crossing the magpie bridge in a dream."

units.source_text: 身边正好有筝，源氏公子取了过来。

en.t: There happened to be a koto nearby, and Prince Genji took it up.

units.source_text: 想起了那年在明石浦上深夜合奏之事，便劝明石姬弹琵琶。

en.t: Remembering how they had played together late at night that year at Akashi Bay, he urged Akashi no Kimi to play the biwa.

units.source_text: 明石姬同他合奏了一会。

en.t: Akashi no Kimi played together with him for a while.

units.source_text: 源氏公子深深赞叹她技巧的高明，觉得无瑕可指。

en.t: Prince Genji deeply admired the brilliance of her skill and thought there was nothing at all to fault.

units.source_text: 奏罢之后，他就把小女公子的近况详细告诉她。

en.t: After they finished playing, he told her in detail how the little young lady was doing.
